prompt: A split courtroom scene places a defendant at the center scales of justice: on the left an imminent blaze with a child trapped inside as a bystander smashes the window and pulls the child free, the jury nodding because the threat is immediate, the damage proportionate and no legal alternative existed; on the right climate, anti-war and AI-safety activists chain themselves across an office doorway while gesturing toward a far, hazy horizon of melting ice, distant bombs and a speculative glowing superintelligence, the same jury turning away because those harms remain remote and political, so the blockade stays ordinary trespass rather than recast emergency rescue.
